welcome.lead: Life shouldn't wait for free time.
welcome.sub: Every week Ryk helps you live one experience — not a task, but a story.

place.title: Where are you now?
place.hint: So we suggest things within reach: events, weather and holidays of your city.
place.failed: Couldn't detect it. Pick your city.
place.far: Ryk doesn't work in any city near you yet. Pick “another city” — stories that aren't tied to a place will still come.

inspire.title: Joy isn't measured by size
inspire.line: A full day doesn't need a big event. It needs you to notice one small thing.
inspire.question: Which of these sound like you?

categories.title: What makes you feel alive?
categories.hint: Pick everything that resonates — just tap.

climb.title: Beginner climbing gym
climb.note: Instructor and gear included. Come solo if you like.

kayak.title: Sunrise kayaking
kayak.note: Groups up to 6. No experience needed.

organ.title: Organ by candlelight
organ.note: A classical program in an old hall. Tickets usually available.

pottery.title: Pottery workshop
pottery.note: The master fires your piece. Come as a pair.

dinner.title: Dinner with strangers
dinner.note: Eight people at a shared table, home cooking.

rooftop.title: Sunrise on a rooftop
rooftop.note: An early start — and the city feels brand new.

call.title: Call someone you haven't spoken to in a year
call.note: No reason, no explaining the silence.

film.title: The film you kept putting off
film.note: That one, from the list. All of it, phone away.

alone.title: Have dinner alone at a restaurant
alone.note: No phone on the table. The first ten minutes are the strangest.

letter.title: A letter to yourself a year from now
letter.note: By hand, sealed, hidden where you won't find it soon.

cold.title: Step into cold water
cold.note: River, sea, shower. Three minutes, breathe slowly.

help.title: A day at an animal shelter
help.note: Walking and cleaning. One-time visits are fine.

params.title: Your week's boundaries
params.note: you can change all of this later
params.error: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again — everything you entered is still here.

moment.title: When was the last time it felt genuinely good?
moment.hint: One occasion. A couple of lines is enough to tell what suits you.
moment.placeholder: Last summer, on the roof with my brother until sunrise…

postponed.title: What have you wanted for ages but never done?
postponed.hint: The thing that rolls over year after year. We'll save it as a wish.
postponed.placeholder: Learn to swim. Go to Georgia. Ask her out.

rhythm.title: What gets in the way most often?
rhythm.hint: Knowing the reason, we suggest a way around it instead of nagging.

memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: Stories that might never have happened.
memory.empty: Lived stories will show up here.

year.title: What the year was made of
year.note: There's no target here and no quota. Only what happened.
year.empty: The year is just starting. Your first lived story will show up here.

meta.title: Ryk — one real story every week
meta.description: A personal AI companion for lived experience: it helps you stop postponing life and live one experience every week.
